segments.sn35.97:1.4: Cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutassa, bhikkhave, viharato cittaṃ byāsiñcati [byāsiccati (sī. syā. kaṃ.)]. Cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu tassa byāsittacittassa pāmojjaṃ na hoti.
segments.sn35.97:1.11: Dhammānaṃ apātubhāvā pamādavihārī tveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati … pe … jivhindriyaṃ asaṃvutassa, bhikkhave, viharato cittaṃ byāsiñcati jivhāviññeyyesu rasesu, tassa byāsittacittassa … pe … pamādavihārī tveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati … pe … manindriyaṃ asaṃvutassa, bhikkhave, viharato cittaṃ byāsiñcati manoviññeyyesu dhammesu, tassa byāsittacittassa pāmojjaṃ na hoti.
segments.sn35.97:1.22: Dhammānaṃ apātubhāvā pamādavihārī tveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
segments.sn35.97:2.2: Cakkhundriyaṃ saṃvutassa, bhikkhave, viharato cittaṃ na byāsiñcati cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu, tassa abyāsittacittassa pāmojjaṃ jāyati.
segments.sn35.97:2.9: Dhammānaṃ pātubhāvā appamādavihārī tveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati … pe … jivhindriyaṃ saṃvutassa, bhikkhave, viharato cittaṃ na byāsiñcati … pe … appamādavihārī tveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
segments.sn35.97:2.12: Manindriyaṃ saṃvutassa, bhikkhave, viharato cittaṃ na byāsiñcati, manoviññeyyesu dhammesu, tassa abyāsittacittassa pāmojjaṃ jāyati.
segments.sn35.97:2.19: Dhammānaṃ pātubhāvā appamādavihārī tveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.

lines: Catutthe asaṃvutassāti apihitassa na pidahitvā sañchāditvā ṭhapitassa.
Imasmiṃ sutte puggalaṃ pucchitvā vibhajantena dhammena puggalo dassito.
Na pidahitvā cakkhundriyaṃ na pidahitvā sañchāditvā ṭhitassa.
“Kathañca, bhikkhave, pamādavihārī hotī”tiādinā puggalaṃ pucchitvā “pāmojjaṃ na hoti, pāmojjaṃ jāyatī”tiādinā ca, dhammena “pamādavihārī appamādavihārī”ti ca puggalo dassito.
